examples.label: hello
joins
examples.sql:
-- the five customers who spent the most, cancelled orders left out
SELECT c.name, c.city, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, sum(i.qty * i.unit_price) AS spent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city
ORDER BY spent DESC, c.id
LIMIT 5;

examples.label: windows
examples.sql:
-- purchases per day in the first week of april, with a running total
SELECT occurred_at::date AS day,
       count(*) AS purchases,
       sum(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY occurred_at::date) AS running_total
FROM events
WHERE kind = 'purchase'
  AND occurred_at >= '2026-04-01' AND occurred_at < '2026-04-08'
GROUP BY occurred_at::date
ORDER BY day;

golden.sql:

examples.label: recursive
examples.sql:
-- everyone under employee 3, two levels down, with their depth
WITH RECURSIVE reports AS (
  SELECT id, name, title, manager_id, 0 AS depth
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.id, e.name, e.title, e.manager_id, r.depth + 1
  FROM employees AS e
  JOIN reports AS r ON e.manager_id = r.id
  WHERE r.depth < 2
)
SELECT depth, id, name, title
FROM reports
ORDER BY depth, id;

golden.sql:
